div.head: II As 23.1
div.ab: ⁊ gif hit sy wæter, þæt he gedufe ðreo healf elne on ðæm rape; gif hit sy isen, syn ðreo nihte, ær mon ða hand ondó.
⁊ gif hit sy wæter, ðæt he gedufe oþre healfe elne on þam rape; gif hit sy ysenordal, beon ðreo niht, ær mon þa hond undó.
… ter, þæt he gedufe oðer healfe elne on ðam rape; gif hit …, ::on ðreo niht, ær mon þa hand ondo.
Et si iudicium aquę (frigide) sit, tunc (in)mergatur una ulna et dimidia in fune. Si ferrum (calidum) sit, tres noctes transeant, antequam (inquiratur et) uideatur manus eius.
⁊ gif hit sy wæter, ðæt he gedufe oþre healfe elne on þam rape; gif hit sy ysenordale, beon ðreo niht, ær mon þa hond undó.
And if the ordeal is by water he shall sink to a depth of one-and-a-half ells on the rope. If the ordeal is by [hot] iron three days shall elapse before the hand is unwrapped.
And if it is [the ordeal of] water, he is to sink one and a half ells on the rope; if it is the ordeal of iron, it is to be three days before the hand is unbound.

Und wenn es Wasser[-Ordal] ist: dass er [zum Erweise der Unschuld mindestens] anderthalb Ellen an dem Seile untersinke; wenn es Eisenordal ist, sollen drei Tage vergehen, bevor man die [wegen Brandwunden verbundene] Hand aufmacht [um aus dem Heilen Unschuld zu erkennen].

And if it is the water[-ordeal]: that he sink [to prove his innocence, at least] one and a half ells on the rope; if it is the iron ordeal, three days are to pass before the hand [bound up because of burns] is unwrapped [to judge innocence from the healing].
div.note: Ld reads ‘ðreo healf elne’ where H and Ot have ‘oþre healfe’ (= one and a half).
